patterns: How can I reset my password?
I cannot login to my account
response: You can reset your password using the 'Forgot Password' option on the login page. Enter your registered email address and we will send you a secure password reset link.

patterns: What if I don't receive the email?
I did not get the email
What if the email does not arrive?
follow_ups.response: If you don't receive the password reset email within 5 minutes, please check your Spam or Junk folder. Also ensure you entered the exact email linked to your account. If it still doesn't arrive, you can request a new link after 10 minutes or contact our support team.

patterns: How long is the reset link valid?
follow_ups.response: The password reset link is valid for 24 hours from the time of request for security reasons. After that, you will need to request a new one.

patterns: How do I create a new account?
How to register or sign up?
response: To create a new account, click the 'Sign Up' or 'Register' button on the top right corner of the home page. Fill in your name, email, and choose a strong password, then verify your email address.

patterns: Does it cost anything to sign up?
follow_ups.response: Yes, creating a standard account is completely free of charge.

patterns: How can I track my order?
response: You can track your order by navigating to 'My Orders' in your account dashboard and clicking 'Track Order'. We also send tracking details to your email once your package ships.

patterns: What if the tracking number doesn't work?
follow_ups.response: Tracking numbers may take up to 24 hours to become active after the label is generated by the courier. If it still doesn't update after 24 hours, please share your Order ID with us.
Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days depending on your location.

patterns: How do returns and refunds work?
response: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can request a return or full refund within 30 days of receipt through the 'Returns' section.

patterns: How long does the refund take to process?
When will the money be in my bank?
How many days to receive refund?
follow_ups.response: Once approved, refunds typically take 5-7 business days to reflect in your original payment method, depending on your bank or card issuer.
Return shipping is completely free for defective or incorrect items. For standard returns, a prepaid shipping label is provided and deducted from the refund amount.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay with credit card or PayPal?
response: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and direct bank transfers for select regions.

patterns: Is it safe to use my credit card?
Do you store my card details?
follow_ups.response: Yes, all transactions are processed through 256-bit SSL encryption and PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways. We do not store your raw card details on our servers.

patterns: How can I talk to a human agent?
Customer care phone number and email
response: You can reach our human support team via email at support@company.com or by calling 1-800-555-0199. Our team is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
Hello! I am your AI Support Assistant. How can I help you today with your account, orders, payments, or general questions?
You're very welcome! If you need assistance with anything else in the future, don't hesitate to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
